From Learning to Playing

An interactive talk for young musicians at Overture Music Intensive: how AI is helping my music journey. From improvising on a fixed-scale handpan at DWeb Camp, to blending the world's scales for an experimental play, to using AI to learn regions, understand your own taste, and build the tools you play with.
